question: Dev pointed to a picture of an old lady and said, “She is the sister of my wife’s son’s grandfather.” How is the old lady related to Dev?
solution:
From the information we draw a tree using the symbols:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

My wife’s son’s grandfather = My father

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8038654bb923e50219f98a3b5989e086b3686c4368fddd7ee907f7fe256b1432.png] 

We can see that **the old lady is Dev's paternal aunt. (Father's sister)**

Hence the correct answer is option 1**)
